deals.target: Media Commerce Service Business and Assets of CJ ENM CO., Ltd.
deals.comment: DADA MNC CO.,Ltd acquired Media Commerce Service Business and Assets of CJ ENM CO., Ltd. for approximately KRW 5.7 billion on February 4, 2021. The board of directors of CJ ENM CO., Ltd. resolved the deal on February 4, 2021.
CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) acquired the remaining 29.98% stake in Artworks Korea Co, Ltd. for KRW 1.8 billion on June 29, 2022.

deals.target: Business unit of CJ E&M Corporation
deals.comment: Artworks Korea Co, Ltd. agreed to acquire Business unit from CJ E&M Corporation for KRW 14.5 billion on December 21, 2022. The deal is expected to close on January 2, 2023.

deals.target: Business of The Rockport Company Korea Co., Ltd.
deals.comment: Artworks Korea Co, Ltd. agreed to acquire Business of The Rockport Company Korea Co., Ltd. for KRW 5.7 billion on October 26, 2023. As of December 31, 2022, Business of The Rockport Company Korea Co., Ltd. reported total assets of KRW 28.8 billion. The deal is expected to be completed on December 1, 2023.

deals.sellers: Mirae Asset Global Investments Co., Ltd.
deals.comment: CJ ENM CO., Ltd. (KOSDAQ:A035760) agreed to acquire remaining 41.176471% stake in DADA MNC CO.,Ltd from Mirae Asset Global Investments Co., Ltd. for KRW 26.05 billion on November 23, 2023.
